scope_of_use: Multiple myeloma, high-dose conditioning before autologous stem cell transplantation, adults.

regimen.schedule: Day -3 and Day -2 before autologous stem cell transplantation
regimen.quote: The recommended dose of Evomela for conditioning treatment is 100 mg/m2/day administered over 30 minutes by intravenous infusion for 2 consecutive days (Day -3 and Day -2) prior to autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT, Day 0).

cmax_single_100_mg_m2_ug_ml.quote: Mean (± SD) peak plasma concentrations and AUC0-inf were 5.8 ± 1.5 mcg/mL and 451 ± 109 mcg*min/mL, respectively, following administration of melphalan 100 mg/m2 in multiple myeloma patients.
cmax_single_100_mg_m2_ug_ml.note: Which dose of the two (Day -3 or Day -2) is not stated; read as one 30-minute infusion with no drug present before it.

volume_of_distribution_l_m2.quote: The volume of distribution of melphalan ranges from approximately 35.5 to 185.7 L/m2.
volume_of_distribution_l_m2.note: The type of volume (steady state, terminal or central) is not stated.

terminal_half_life_min.quote: Melphalan terminal elimination half-life is approximately 75 minutes.

clearance_ml_min_m2.quote: Average total body clearance (CL) ranges from approximately 250 to 325 mL/min/m2.

fraction_excreted_urine.quote: Mean values of melphalan excreted in urine range from 5.8% to 21.3%.

elimination_route.quote: Melphalan primarily undergoes chemical hydrolysis to inactive metabolites.

protein_binding_percent.quote: Protein binding of melphalan ranges from approximately 50% to 90%, primarily to serum albumin (40% to 60%) and to a lesser extent to α1-acid glycoprotein (20%).

linearity.note: Only the 100 mg/m2 dose is reported; dose proportionality is not stated.

ideal_body_weight_45_kg.study_population: not stated (covariate effect; likely from a population PK analysis)
ideal_body_weight_45_kg.quote: Melphalan clearance changes with ideal body weight (IBW), which decreased by 28% and increased by 31% with IBW of 45 kg and 100 kg compared to 70 kg IBW, respectively.

ideal_body_weight_100_kg.study_population: not stated (covariate effect; likely from a population PK analysis)

creatinine_clearance_30_ml_min.relative_to: estimated creatinine clearance 100 mL/min, IBW 70 kg
creatinine_clearance_30_ml_min.study_population: not stated (covariate effect; likely from a population PK analysis)
creatinine_clearance_30_ml_min.quote: A decrease in estimated creatinine CL from 100 mL/min to 30 mL/min results in 28.2% reduction in CL for a typical person with an IBW of 70 kg.

scenario_note: Melphalan scenarios state a change in clearance (not in AUC), so they are applied as CL multiplied by the factor. The clearance in the label is per m2 of body surface area while the covariate effects are stated for ideal body weight; the label does not say how the two combine, so the factors are applied to the typical per-m2 curve and labelled as such.
not_stated: Which of the two conditioning doses the Cmax and AUC describe, and the sampling schedule.
Whether the volume range is steady-state, terminal or central volume.
The population behind the clearance, volume and half-life ranges.
Hepatic impairment and drug interaction effects on exposure.
